'''Corr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who sold combat gear aboard the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Carrick Station]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Corr first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a PvP Gear Vendor. Corr's appearance and gear was changed with the release of Game Update 2.0, when the elder game gear system was overhauled.
